svg.title: StitchLLM: serving LLMs one block at a time
svg.desc: A request passes through the bottom decoder blocks of a large LLM, a trained stitching layer that maps hidden size 4096 to 2048, and the top blocks of a small LLM. As the request load rises, the scheduler moves the stitch point to use fewer large-model blocks, trading accuracy gradually instead of jumping between model sizes.

g.text: Decoder blocks of a large and a small LLM
A trained stitching layer joins them
Load spikes → scheduler moves the stitch point
